???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What do we call an operand that supplies a tensor result's starting shape and contents, without itself being modified in place?"

        The destination, in destination-passing style. On memrefs the same operand is the memory that is actually written, and the operation returns nothing.

        Introduced in [M5. Structured ops: linalg, tensor and memref](m5-structured-ops.md).

    ??? question "Which MLIR type is an immutable value with a shape and element type but no address, unlike a memref?"

        A tensor value. Nothing can write through it; an operation that appears to change one produces a new tensor instead.

        Introduced in [M5. Structured ops: linalg, tensor and memref](m5-structured-ops.md).

    ??? question "Which MLIR type names a shaped, typed reference to a region of memory, with a layout such as row-major order?"

        A memref. It behaves like a Vortex `&mut` argument, except that nothing in the type itself rules out two memrefs aliasing.

        Introduced in [M2. Reading MLIR](m2-reading-mlir.md).
